rule: NEVER GET STUCK. If Plan A fails, execute Plan B immediately. Continue A→Z. Q is always the emergency backup lane.

J.name: Historical evidence preserve
J.action: Copy current evidence to *-HISTORICAL-*.json before overwrite

K.name: Portable path repair
K.action: Replace hardcoded Desktop roots with $PSScriptRoot / relative roots

L.name: Venv recovery
L.action: Recreate alphaevolve-on-googlecloud\.venv using bundled/local Python only

M.name: Google Cloud SDK Python fallback
M.action: Use preinstalled Google Cloud SDK Python if system python/uv blocked

N.name: WSL fallback for Linux-only tools
N.action: Use WSL only when Windows native path fails for toolkit binaries

O.name: Docs/codelab offline path
O.action: Operate from local docs/ + cached HTML only; no cloud calls

P.name: Snapshot isolation mode
P.action: Treat Desktop snapshot as immutable reference; write only under A11-OWNER-RUNTIME

Q.name: EMERGENCY BACKUP LANE
actions: Stop claiming blocked if any local proof still runs
Serve monitor on next free loopback port 8767-8770
Write FAIL-FORWARD.json with exact error + next route
Open MONITOR.md + STATUS.md as human fallback UI
Keep cloud path GATED; continue local value

R.name: Canonical workspace handoff
R.action: Copy only proven runtime artifacts into C:\Users\ANGEL\MRPRODUCTION\reports with timestamp

S.name: Read-only gcloud identity check
S.command: gcloud auth list; gcloud projects describe mind-reply-496111

V.name: Owner-gated GE_APP_ID set
V.action: Replace only GE_APP_ID=UNVERIFIED with real Engine/App ID

W.name: Owner-gated API enable review
W.action: Consider discoveryengine.googleapis.com enable only after T+U+V PROVEN

X.name: Remote AlphaEvolve dry-run design
X.action: Prepare remote run plan without executing mutations

Y.name: Owner-gated remote execution
Y.action: Execute remote AlphaEvolve only with explicit CEO approval

Z.name: Full stop + evidence seal
Z.action: Seal PROOF/BENCHMARK/STATUS/MONITOR evidence, report blockers, no silent retry loops

every_agent_must: On failure jump to on_fail immediately
forbidden: Wait idly when a local alternative exists
Substitute project id/number/sa email for GE_APP_ID
